Miku's Adventures - Spring Summer?

fiogutz

Summary:

It's Numbuh 3 and Parfait Cookie's birthday, and to celebrate it, Miku goes to a beach resort! Meanwhile with the villains they are going to crash this birthday party with all their might!

Chapter 1

Chapter Text

[tv opening type thing, then we see Mr Tumble and Tophat (The Nightly Manor) standing.]

Mr Tumble: Good morning, everyone! Did you know, that me and my friend here, Tophat have sold a resort?

Tophat: Wait- We DID?! Dude- I thought that was a jok-

Mr Tumble: Gee, I'm sorry for lying to you, but it was a surprise! So, do you wanna know who ordered the house?

???: Ooh! I wanna! I wanna!

Tophat: Sketchpad?! Ur not supposed to talk during this filming!

Sketchpad (The Nightly Manor): Oh- Sorry! But, can you PLEEEEEASE tell us, Mr Tumble?

Mr Tumble: Of course! Our lucky person- Or should I say people is Grad- I mean, Miku and her lovely friends!!!

Tophat: ... Who?

Mr Tumble: Hm? You don't know? She's one of the most high raising popstars in japan!

Tophat: I have never went to japan. Ever.

Mr Tumble: Oh. Well- See you next time, folks!

[The tv then turns off, and we hear a growl]

???: Grrr.. She can't keep getting away with this! First Shadow Milk and his gang got beat by that other one, and now MIKU'S TAKING HER PLACE LIKE ITS NOTHING?!

[Turns out, it's Burning Spice Cookie! He had other villians in this headquaters too, such as B Block (animatic battle), Black Forest Cake Cookie, Alrrechio, c00lkidd, Vox, and Eternal Sugar Cookie.]

Eternal Sugar Cookie: Yawnnn~ Why do you even care so much about her..?

Burning Spice Cookie: This blue haired-japanese popstar is trying to cover up what happened last time! Don't you remember Gradient Sparkle?! That stupid bitch who always git her way! Haven't you seen her?! She has teamed up with ancients! ANCIENTS!

Vox: And she's pretty annoying too, she gets EVERYTHING her way..

Burning Spice Cookie: YES! And she was only powerful cause of her MILLIONS OF FRIENDS. AND I GUESS SHE FUCKING TURNED IT DOWN TO THE JAPANESE CH-

Alrrechio: That's enough, Burning Spice.

Eternal Sugar Cookie: Wait, let him yap~!

B Block: Yes! We need to hear his mischevious ideas!

c00lkidd: Ideas?

Burning Spice Cookie: Thanks Eternal. But, seriously! It's like she's trying to steal OUR power!

Black Forest Cake Cookie: Then why don't we just.. Be better?

Burning Spice Cookie: .... Be better? What do you MEAN by that?!

Black Forest Cake Cookie: You see, Shadow Milk and his gang only showed up at the front door and did some powers, they were effortless. So why don't we stop being lazy like them?

Burning Spice Cookie: Black Forest.. That is... A HORRIBLE IDEA! What would we even DO?!

Eternal Sugar Cookie: I heard that it's Numbuh 3 and Parfait Cookie's birthday today..

Burning Spice Cookie: .. And?

B Block: AND WE CAN KIDNAP THEM!

c00lkidd: YAYYY! AND THEN WE GET ICE CREAM TO FEED THEM AND THEN WE GO A CARASOUSLS!

Burning Spice Cookie: You're a fucking idiot.

Allrechio: ... I'm outta here.

Burning Spice Cookie: But then yet again.. I kinda like B Block's idea.

Vox: Now- Let me tell you something, along with that, we can make a robot Shadow Milk Cookie. To give them a signal.

Burning Spice Cookie: YES! YES! THIS PLAN IS COMING TOGETHER!

c00lkidd: YAYYY! PLANS!!!

Burning Spice Cookie: YES! WE CAN BE STRONGER THAN EVERRRR!
